lead_raw_text:
The structure of ThTl₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms—two Th and four Tl—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Th and Tl centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each, at a uniform neighbor distance of 3.5823 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Tl-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Th- and Tl-centered polyhedra.
